name: Grafaiai
description: Grafaiai, the Toxic Monkey Pokémon, and the evolved form of Shroodle. A Poison and Normal type.
pokedex_entries: The color of the poisonous saliva depends on what the Pokémon eats. Grafaiai covers its fingers in its saliva and draws patterns on trees in forests.
Each Grafaiai paints its own individual pattern, and it will paint that same pattern over and over again throughout its life.
